tasks.description: Hold Google Barkour vB in an upright standing posture at the current location.
Adjust Google Barkour vB to the specified body height and hold upright at the current location.
Move Google Barkour vB forward in its initial body-yaw direction for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
Move Google Barkour vB laterally in its initial body-yaw frame for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
Move the four Google Barkour vB legs to the specified symmetric posture and hold it.
